verdict.rationale: Audience export applies to an email marketing platform, but the evidence pack never documents exporting contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, or suppression lists in an open format. The Marketing Emails API retrieves email objects and send statistics, not audience records. Salesforce sync and exclusion segments are adjacent features, not self-serve export.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve
